module_title: Advanced Framework - Minor Gharanas, the Dhrupad Tradition, and Music Institutions
introduction: Curated for UPPSC Mains (GS Papers 5 & 6) and highly analytical Prelims papers, this tier covers the smaller instrumental gharanas, the ancient Dhrupad singing style, and the foundational years of UP's premier cultural institutions.

core_concepts.title: Rampur-Sahaswan Gharana
core_concepts.description:
- **Locations:** Rampur and Sahaswan (Budaun district).
- **Founder:** Ustad Inayat Hussain Khan (An offshoot of the Gwalior Gharana).
- **Significance:** Known for singing complex 'Taans' and high-pitch (Tar Saptak) melodies. Ustad Mushtaq Hussain Khan, the first vocalist to receive the Padma Bhushan, belonged to this Gharana.

core_concepts.title: Etawah / Gauripur Gharana
core_concepts.description:
- **Significance:** This is a purely **Instrumental Gharana** (Vadan Gharana). It specializes primarily in the Sitar and the Surbahar.
- **Key Figures:** Ustad Imdad Khan, Ustad Enayat Khan, and Ustad Vilayat Khan.

core_concepts.title: The Dhrupad Tradition & Swami Haridas
core_concepts.description:
- **Mathura (Vrindavan):** Swami Haridas, a contemporary of Emperor Akbar, developed the Dhrupad-Dhamar style of singing in Vrindavan. Dhrupad is considered the oldest and purest form of Hindustani classical music.
- **Legacy:** The legendary Tansen and Baiju Bawra were disciples of Swami Haridas. (Legend has it that Akbar had to visit Vrindavan in disguise just to hear Haridas sing).

core_concepts.title: Major Cultural Institutions of UP
core_concepts.description:
- **Bhatkhande Music Institute:** Located in Lucknow. Established in **1926** (originally as Marris College of Music). It was granted Deemed University status in 2001 and is now a State University.
- **State Lalit Kala Akademi:** Lucknow (Established in **1962** - focuses on fine arts).
- **UP Sangeet Natak Akademi:** Lucknow (Established in **1963** - focuses on performing arts).

important_entities.name: Begum Akhtar
important_entities.significance: Born in Faizabad and musically rooted in the Lucknow Gharana, Begum Akhtar is immortalized as the 'Mallika-e-Ghazal' (Queen of Ghazals). She took Awadhi Thumri, Dadra, and Ghazals to global heights.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: The institute was renamed after Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande in 1960. However, if an exam asks for the foundation year of the institution, you MUST select **1926** (the year it was established as Marris College). This is a highly tested institutional timeline.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: UP established the Lalit Kala (Fine Arts/Painting) Akademi first in 1962, followed exactly one year later by the Sangeet Natak (Acting/Music) Akademi in 1963. Both are headquartered in Lucknow.

exam_strategy_tips: In UPPSC Mains, when writing an answer on UP's musical heritage, mentioning smaller niches like the 'Etawah Gharana' for Surbahar and the 'Rampur-Sahaswan Gharana' adds immense depth and distinguishes your answer from average responses that only mention Lucknow and Benares.
